description: This PHP file defines a function that generates the body of a date/time combo widget for the SuiteCRM platform. It sets default values, handles user time format preferences, and prepares data for the template rendering of a datetime input form.

classes.name: TemplateDatetimecombo
classes.description: A class used to generate date and time string mappings for the datetime combo widget.

methods.name: get_body
methods.description: Generates context data for rendering a datetime combo widget in the templating system, setting default values and interpreting user preferences.
